.SH "NAME"
\fBnpm-update\fR - Update packages
.SS "Synopsis"
.P
.RS 2
.nf
npm update \[lB]<pkg>...\[rB]

aliases: up, upgrade, udpate
.fi
.RE
.SS "Description"
.P
